equipment_type: Hospitality lighting and HVAC control system (BACnet IP area device)
applies_to: Lutron myRoom hospitality guestroom control systems (software 3.3) with BACnet integration; each guestroom area is its own virtual BACnet device.
summary: A myRoom processor speaks BACnet IP and routes to one virtual device per guestroom area. Each area device has fixed objects for light level, lighting state, scene, occupancy, power and failure counters, plus HVAC zone objects (temperature, mode, fan, setpoint, drift) and one object per lighting zone, shade group, 3-wire motor zone, temperature sensor and keypad.
notes: Names in braces ({ZoneName}, {HVACZoneName}, {ShadeGroupName}, {KeypadName}...) take the names set in the myRoom project.

Only the first instance of each repeating range is listed: zone levels 1000-1099, shade levels 2000-2999, shade presets 3000-3999, 3-wire motors 5000-5099, supply air sensors 7300-7399 (C) and 7400-7499 (F), keypads 8000-8999.
HVAC temperature, operating state and fan state are read-only when the HVAC unit is on the thermostat's Modbus link, and must be written by the BMS when the HVAC unit is connected over BACnet.
Occupancy State reflects the room's sensors; Lutron reports guest presence (GPD) through a state variable on the myRoom main device.

source.title: BACnet PIC Statement for myRoom Virtual Devices Using Version 3.3

integration.summary: The BACnet base and system numbers are set in the myRoom configuration software; each guestroom then shows up as a virtual device behind the myRoom processor. Read occupancy (MV 8) and lighting power, command scenes (MV 4) or level (AV 2), and use the HVAC zone objects for mode, setpoint and fan. If the room's HVAC unit is on BACnet, the BMS must write temperature, operating state and fan state to the 71xx objects.

integration.enable: BACnet integration is a licensed feature set up in the myRoom configuration software; there is no BMS enable point.
integration.remote_sensors: When the HVAC unit is connected over BACnet rather than the thermostat's Modbus link, the zone temperature (AV 7100/7103), operating state (MV 7107) and fan state (MV 7109) must be written by the HVAC side so the thermostat can display them and energy reports work.
setup: BACnet IP. The myRoom processor is a router: area virtual devices sit on a virtual network behind the main device.
Area device ID = Base + System + 1; Base default 1760000, System 0-127, both set in the myRoom software.
The processor can register as a foreign device with a BBMD.
gotchas: Lighting Level reports the brightest fixture in the area when fixtures differ; RF zones are not included.
Lutron says objects not described in the PIC may appear in a BACnet browser and should not be used.
Celsius and Fahrenheit objects exist side by side; map one set only.
